title: LabhSathi Schemes Dataset
description: Schema for welfare scheme facts, metadata, and declarative eligibility criteria.

name.description: Full official scheme name including acronym

authority.description: Central ministry, department, or nodal agency implementing the scheme

benefit.description: Concise summary of direct financial or in-kind assistance provided

category_domain.description: Primary domain of the welfare scheme for grouping and filtering

documents.description: Official documents and proofs required to apply

official_note.description: Important administrative details, SECC verification rules, or statutory conditions

source_url.description: Official portal URL or null if verified link is not yet established

review_date.description: ISO-8601 date when the criteria was last reviewed against official gazette

exclusions.description: Explicit disqualifying conditions (e.g. income-tax payer, institutional owner)

criteria.description: Declarative eligibility parameters evaluated against a UserProfile

max_annual_income.description: Maximum household annual income ceiling in INR (exclusive boundary, i.e. < cap)

min_annual_income.description: Minimum household annual income in INR (inclusive)

occupations.description: Eligible occupations (matches if applicant occupation is in this list)

categories.description: Eligible social categories (matches if applicant category is in this list)

gender.description: Eligible gender (matches if applicant gender equals this)

min_disability_percentage.description: Minimum certified disability percentage required (e.g. 40 or 80)

requires_land.description: Whether owning agricultural land (>0 acres) is required

is_widow.description: Whether applicant must be a widow

is_student.description: Whether applicant must currently be an enrolled student

requires_no_bank_account.description: Whether not having a bank account is required (e.g. for Jan Dhan)

requires_kutcha_house.description: Whether living in a kutcha/temporary shelter is required

is_pregnant_or_lactating.description: Whether applicant must be pregnant or lactating for their first child

max_daughter_age.description: Maximum age of daughter for child schemes (exclusive boundary, i.e. < max)

states.description: Applicable states/UTs (empty or omitted means all India)

match_reason.description: Plain-language sentence explaining why the applicant qualifies
